name: Hollowed Soul
source:
Every year, in late September, a pumpkin will grow. And from that pumpkin, the Spirit of Halloween will appear.

One year, he appeared to Evelyn, a young girl with a lack of Halloween Spirit. They became fast friends, but all things come to an end and the Spirit had to return to the land of Halloween.

But she wasn't about to let him go without a fight.

[From [url=https://sevencents.itch.io/hollowed-soul]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
每年九月下旬，都会有一颗特别的南瓜悄然生长。而从那颗南瓜之中，“万圣节之灵”便会现身人间。

某一年，他出现在了缺乏万圣节热情的小女孩伊芙琳面前。两人很快成了无话不谈的好朋友，然而天下没有不散的筵席，万圣节之灵终究必须返回万圣节之国。

但伊芙琳绝不打算就这样乖乖放他离开。

[摘自[url=https://sevencents.itch.io/hollowed-soul]itch.io[/url]]
